title: Awakening the Zodiac

text.lead: Awakening the Zodiac is a 2017 Canadian mystery crime drama film directed by Jonathan Wright and starring Shane West and Leslie Bibb.
text.plot: A couple buy a storage unit, finding evidence of the Zodiac Killer and try to solve the case.
text.cast:
- Shane West as Mick Branson
- Leslie Bibb as Zoe Branson
- Matt Craven as Harvey
- Kenneth Welsh as Ben
- Nicholas Campbell as Ray
- Stephen McHattie as "Zodiac"
- John Bregar as Adam
- Eva Link as Lula
- Jennie Esnard as Tina
- Douglas Kidd as Officer
- Sandra Wilson as Front Desk Woman
text.production: Although the film is set in Virginia, the film was shot in Ontario, especially in Almonte, outside of Ottawa.
text.reception: The film has 45% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Barry Hertz of The Globe and Mail awarded the film one star out of four.
